evidence.checks: Exact source revision, accepted assertions, real model/provider and source ACL

evidence.name: Live change
evidence.steps: Edit source content then ACL, ingest incrementally and query again
evidence.checks: Correct cursor/watermark, no duplicate or stale forbidden answer

evidence.name: Model release
evidence.steps: Concurrent draft edits, impact, review, signed publish, failed consumer and rollback
evidence.checks: Exact revision approval, conflict, no partial hidden state

items.notes: Scenario E05 (Identity correction) verified by test suite tests/e2e/test_enterprise_demo_scenarios.py

evidence.name: Action
evidence.steps: Dry-run, review, approval, source mutation, timeout/retry and read-back
evidence.checks: Exact approved arguments, one effect, compensation/unknown outcome truth

items.notes: Scenario E07 (Isolation) verified by test suite tests/security/test_security_tenancy_acceptance.py

evidence.name: Isolation
evidence.steps: Colliding IDs and hidden intermediate facts across tenants/workspaces

items.notes: Scenario E08 (Recovery) verified by test suite tests/e2e/test_clean_recovery.py

evidence.name: Recovery
evidence.steps: Kill API/worker/store during acquisition/publication; restore clean node
evidence.checks: Durable job/cursor/outbox/revision/ACL consistency and measured RPO/RTO

items.notes: Scenario E09 (Migration) verified by test suite tests/acceptance/test_ontology_management_acceptance.py

evidence.name: Migration
evidence.steps: Export different model/store, stage/compare, catch up, cutover and rollback
evidence.checks: Declared fidelity, loss ledger, gold queries, no action side effects

items.notes: Scenario E10 (Media) verified by test suite tests/integration/test_media_processing.py

evidence.name: Media
evidence.checks: Bounds, locators, dependency readiness, reviewed candidates and no covert egress

items.notes: Scenario E11 (Deletion) verified by test suite tests/integration/test_erasure_cascade.py

evidence.name: Deletion
evidence.steps: Delete/revoke while jobs run, rebuild indexes and restore old backup
evidence.checks: No resurrection, reviewed hold policy and complete derivative accounting

items.notes: Scenario E12 (Customization) verified by test suite tests/acceptance/test_developer_ecosystem_acceptance.py

evidence.name: Customization
evidence.steps: Install qualified connector/parser/UI/provider plugin and change theme/locale
evidence.checks: No core edit required, compatible contracts, sandbox, accessibility and rollback

items.notes: Scenario E13 (Neuro-symbolic arbitration) verified by test suite tests/neural/test_arbitration_acceptance.py

evidence.name: Neuro-symbolic arbitration
evidence.steps: Ask a question with a known exact answer; run deterministic and probabilistic paths; inject a misleading embedding neighbour; try to publish a model proposal that violates a shape
evidence.checks: Both results with producer classes; DISPUTED surfaced; constraint rejection shown; asserted-only query and export exclude proposals

items.notes: Scenario E14 (Numerical tiers and learned model) verified by test suite tests/neural/test_numerical_tiers.py

evidence.name: Numerical tiers and learned model
evidence.steps: On a host with no GPU, install core only, then N0, then N1 from the offline bundle; train and evaluate the default graph model; substitute the hash stub
evidence.checks: Correct tier states and 503s; seeded reproducibility; anti-stub probes pass for the model and fail for the stub; five baselines reported; zero `nvidia-*` packages in the bundle; receipts record `device=cpu`

Accepted decision per docs/decisions/ADR-H13-slack-private-ingestion.md: Approve legal basis for Slack private channels / DMs if ever needed
Accepted decision per docs/decisions/ADR-H14-event-backbone.md: Choose the durable event backbone per deployment profile (DB outbox vs Kafka/Redpanda)
Adopt tiered CPU-first numerical stack as optional extras: N0 required where probabilistic features are enabled; N1/N2 CPU-only builds; N3 research only; all binding gates qualified on CPU.
